comments: MY NAME IS DR. JAMES BOARD AND I AM THE PRESIDENT OF THE HOME OWNERS ASSOCIATION OF THE CHATSWORTH COURT CONDOMINIUM COMPLEX ON S. KENILWORTH PKWY OFF BURBANK AVE.  THE RECENT CONSTRUCTION OF THE KENILWORTH CROSSING SUBDIVISION ADJACENT TO OUR COMPLEX HAS CREATED A FLOODING THREAT TO CHATSWORTH COURT.  THE BUILDER OF KENILWORTH CROSSING SUBDIVISION HAS EXCAVATED A LARGE AREA IN BACK OF US TO INCREASE THE HEIGHT OF THE SUBDIVISIONS LAND.  A LARGE LAKE HAS FORMED IN THE EXCAVATED AREA.  THIS LAKE, IN ADDITION TO RELATIVELY HIGHER GROUND FOR KENILWORTH CROSSING COMPARED WITH CHATSWORTH COURT, HAVE CREATED A SERIOUS FLOODING PROBLEM FOR OUR COMPLEX.  I WOULD LIKE TO DEMONSTRATE THIS PROBLEM BY FIRST DRAWING YOUR ATTENTION TO IMG-1672, WHICH SHOWS AN OVERALL VIEW OF KENILWORTH CROSSING LAKE WITH THE NEW HOUSES OF THE SUBDIVISION ON THE LEFT HALF OF THE PICTURE AND THE TWO-STORY CHATSWORTH COURT CONDOMINIUM COMPLEX ON THE RIGHT HALF OF THE PICTURE.  ONE CAN SEE THAT KENILWORTH CROSSING IS ON SIGNIFICANTLY HIGHER GROUND RELATIVE TO CHATSWORTH COURT.  A CLOSER EXAMINATION PRESENTS THE PROBLEM MORE CLEARLY.  IMG-1674 SHOWS THE HIGHER GROUND FOR HOMES IN KENILWORTH CROSSING RELATIVE TO THE PARKING LOT OF CHATSWORTH COURT FROM WHERE THE PICTURE WAS TAKEN.  A HEAVY RAINFALL WOULD CHANNEL WATER INTO CHATSWORTH COURT THREATENING THE CONDOMINIUMS WITH FLOODING.  PLEASE VIEW IMG-1677 WHICH SHOWS THE TWO-STORY CONDOMINIUMS OF CHATSWORTH COURT (RIGHT SIDE OF PICTURE) AT A MUCH LOWER LEVEL THAN THE HOUSES OF KENILWORTH CROSSING (LEFT SIDE OF PICTURE).  IMAGE 1680 SHOWS THE SAME PROBLEM.  CHATSWORTH COURT ON THE LEFT SIDE OF THE PICTURE IS SEVERAL FEET LOWER THAN THE RAISED GROUND OF KENILWORTH CROSSING ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE FENCE.  THE EFFECT OF THIS HEIGHT DIFFERENTIAL CAN BE SEEN IN PICTURES TAKEN DURING A RECENT HEAVY RAINFALL EVENT (IMG-2914 AND 2912).
